adversarial_trace.event: Actor A wins PREPARED->ARMED_k by CAS and exact-reads the winning value; actor B can only observe the existing ARMED_k.
History H0: A crashes after exact readback but before target launch. History H1: A performs the target launch and crashes before any matching B(k) evidence becomes durable.
After the crash, repository-visible state is identical in H0 and H1: ARMED_k. The live invocation-local fact that A was the CAS-winning launcher is gone.

Any restarted or overlapping actor that is authorized to launch using repository state alone must make the same decision in H0 and H1. Launching can restore progress in H0 but duplicates a possibly committed non-idempotent effect in H1; refusing to launch preserves safety in H1 but leaves H0 blocked until authoritative matching B(k) or C(k) resolves the ambiguity.

bounded_leaf_result.first_counterexample: Repository state alone cannot reconstruct a crash-surviving creator-only launch capability that is both safe and live across the H0/H1 indistinguishability window. A repository CAS can elect the original live launcher, but once that invocation is lost, the durable ARMED_k value does not encode whether the external launch occurred.
